description: Pick a main, a side and a drink beside the total.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A set (combo) builder: three numbered steps, each a radio group of cards with the price (main, side, drink),
  beside or under a summary with the live total and the order button. Axes: layout (split, stacked), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";
import type { DishOption } from "../components/option-chips.types";

export type ComboBuilderProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  mains: DishOption[];
  sides: DishOption[];
  drinks: DishOption[];
  total: number;
  currency: string;
  layout?: "split" | "stacked";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import OptionChips from "../components/option-chips.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  labels,
  mains,
  sides,
  drinks,
  total,
  currency,
  layout = "split",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ComboBuilderProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <Box
        :class="
          (layout as string) === 'split' ? 'flex flex-col gap-8 lg:col-span-2'
          : 'flex flex-col gap-8 lg:col-span-3'
        "
        data-testid="steps"
      >
        <OptionChips :name="tpl('{0}-main', id)" :legend="labels.main" :options="mains" extra="price" layout="column" />
        <OptionChips :name="tpl('{0}-side', id)" :legend="labels.side" :options="sides" extra="price" layout="column" />
        <OptionChips
          :name="tpl('{0}-drink', id)"
          :legend="labels.drink"
          :options="drinks"
          extra="price"
          layout="column"
        />
      </Box>
      <Stack
        gap="4"
        :class="
          (layout as string) === 'split' ? 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-4 p-6 lg:sticky lg:top-8'
          : 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-4 p-6'
        "
        data-testid="summary"
      >
        <Text size="lg" weight="semibold">
          {{ labels.summary }}
        </Text>
        <Group gap="2" align="baseline" justify="between">
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ labels.total }}
          </Text>
          <Inline class="text-2xl font-bold" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-testid="total">
            {{ fmtMoney(total, currency) }}
          </Inline>
        </Group>
        <Button variant="default" size="lg" type="button" class="w-full">
          <LucideIcon name="shopping-bag" :size="16" />
          {{ labels.add }}
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
